title: Which job should I take?
instructions: Ayşe iki iş teklifini arkadaşıyla konuşuyor. Uzun bir diyalog; hangi bilginin hangi işe ait olduğunu karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: Mark, I need some advice. I've got two job offers, and I can't decide.

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: The first one is at a big bank in the city centre. The salary is very good, about forty thousand a year.

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: It's at a small design company. The salary is lower, thirty-two thousand, but the work is more interesting.

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: At the bank, I would work from eight to six, sometimes later. At the design company, it's nine to five, and I can work from home on Fridays.

script.speaker: mark
script.text: How far are they from your flat?

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: The bank is an hour by train. The design company is only fifteen minutes by bike.

script.speaker: mark
script.text: Honestly, money isn't everything. You'd have more free time with the second job.

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: You're right. I think I'll take the design job.

questions.prompt: How much is the salary at the bank?
questions.feedback: Bankadaki maaş yaklaşık kırk bin; tasarım şirketi otuz iki bin.

questions.prompt: What is better about the design company?
questions.feedback: Maaş daha düşük ama iş daha ilginç.
questions.evidence: but the work is more interesting.

questions.prompt: When can Ayşe work from home at the design company?
questions.feedback: Tasarım şirketinde cuma günleri evden çalışabilir.
questions.evidence: I can work from home on Fridays.

questions.prompt: How does Ayşe get to the design company?
questions.feedback: Tasarım şirketi bisikletle on beş dakika; banka trenle bir saat.
questions.evidence: The design company is only fifteen minutes by bike.
I think I'll take the design job.
